{{Quote|T7 &#61; 12 other partners // T7 + doctor // T7 + mechanic // T7 + Senator's aide // T7 + others|translated=1|T7-O1|<ref name="Zallow">{{TORcite|type=conversation|T7-O1|Master Zallow}}</ref>}}
A '''mechanic''' was the owner and partner of the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]] sometime during T7-O1's two [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] of activity. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and mechanic eventually parted ways<ref name="Zallow" /> sometime before the beginning of the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' establishes that [[T7-O1]] was active for at least 200 years, and information gathered from other conversations with T7-O1 makes it clear that the droid was partnered with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ven Zallow]] for the entire [[Great Galactic War]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This mechanic was first mentioned by T7-O1, a companion character for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]]. In the conversation "Master Zallow," T7-O1 names the mechanic as one of his twelve previous partners, though he does not specify the individual's name, [[Species/Legends|species]], or [[Gender/Legends|gender]].<ref name="Zallow" />
